info.title: Truto SDK fixes to the published OpenAPI spec

actions.description: The spec types body as an object, but its own description says values may be any JSON type, and live integrations (greythr) send a JSON array. Typed as any JSON so the integration catalog decodes.

body.description: Static or templated request body for `post`/`put`/`patch` methods. Any JSON value (usually an object, sometimes an array) and may include placeholders. Use `$truto_merge` with `:json` to deep-merge an entire object; see placeholder syntax.

actions.description: Same as IntegrationResourceMethod.body: an override body may be any JSON value.

body.description: Override the request body for this method. Any JSON value; may include JSONata placeholders.
